source.title: Japanese Toro
source.author: 3dlunatic
source.contribution: Local 3D weathering residuals sampled from the licensed shaft surface only. Donor whole silhouette, macro shaft envelope, roof, fire chamber and captured ground are excluded. Missing-scan regions interpolate nearby captured samples; residuals are clamped to ±12 mm and applied to a new target-controlled square profile.
source.attribution: Japanese Toro by 3dlunatic, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab and public Objaverse; modified in the temple-cinema Tōrō156 study. New roof/frame/lattice/stonework and further edits are documented in r05/report.json.

authoredGeometry: Broad chipped six-sided curved cap with real thick underside/downturned fascia/raised hips; spherical finial; hollow six-window stone chamber; actual cast lattice, recessed emitting paper, closed heavy platform, lobed lotus receiver, carved petals, irregular plinth.
coordinateSystem: GLB Y-up; native adapter seats the true minimum Y at zero, sets height 4.05 and roof maximum plan half-width 1.06 by a declared 3D normalization.
limits: Standalone Cycles material uses metric box sampling and granular bump; native adapter uses the original map/normal/roughness images with metric geometry UVs and vertex age colors. They are independent PBR implementations, not identical pixels.
Exact HD ornament and weathering patterns remain unaccepted. The model is an authored reference-guided variant, not a scan of the supplied photograph.
No source07 integration, anchoring or live lighting was changed.
